verdict.rationale: Paychex runs a developer portal documenting a REST API for automating Paychex integrations. The docs cover OAuth 2.0 security, versioning, paging, rate limiting, worker and webhook resources, and use cases such as maintaining employee data and creating complex checks. That lets a programmatic consumer drive core payroll and HR functions. Access appears to depend on 'Paychex client access', and probes found no published machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), an llms.txt (404), clarity on how open access is beyond client credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
